name: Shipt
description: Shipt helps users find available grocery retailers, browse products, build and edit a private cart, and continue checkout in the Shipt shopping experience through Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Shipt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Shipt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://member-api.shipt.com/marketplace-mcp/v2.0/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Shipt MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shipt provides these MCP tools: Browse and Shop.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Shipt?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Shipt in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Shipt requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Shipt is developed by Shipt. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
